cleavage agent: processed by in-gel trypsinization followed by LC-MS/MS analysis
collision energy: Fragmentation conditions in the LTQ were as follows: normalized collision energy, 40%
enrichment method: an m7GTP-Sepharose enrichment was performed to determine the effect of viral infection on the composition of eIF4E-containing cap-binding complexes
fractionation method: These samples were subject to SDS-PAGE electrophoresis and processed by in-gel trypsinization
instrument: LC-MS/MS analysis on a Orbitrap Velos instrument at the University of Bristol
ionization type: Peptides were ionized by nanoelectrospray ionization at 2.1 kV
labeling: A SILAC-based mass spectrometry approach was employed to analyze changes to protein abundance
